storylines.title: The Adventure Begins
storylines.description: Our heroes embark on their first adventure

pages.title: The Adventure Begins, Page 1
pages.alt: A hero stands at the edge of a forest, looking determined
pages.transcript:
Panel 1: A young hero stands at the edge of a dense forest.
Hero: "Today, I begin my journey."
pages.commentary: This is where it all started!

pages.title: The Adventure Begins, Page 2
pages.alt: The hero meets a mysterious companion
pages.transcript:
Panel 1: The hero walks into the forest.
Panel 2: A mysterious figure appears.
Figure: "I've been waiting for you."

storylines.title: New Horizons
storylines.description: The journey continues to new lands

pages.title: New Horizons, Page 1
pages.alt: The heroes arrive at a coastal village
pages.transcript:
Panel 1: Our heroes arrive at a bustling coastal village.
Hero: "We made it!"
Companion: "This is just the beginning."

pages.title: New Horizons, Page 2
pages.alt: A ship waits at the harbor
pages.transcript:
Panel 1: A magnificent ship waits at the harbor.
Panel 2: The captain greets them.
Captain: "Ready to set sail?"
